<context_for_action>
The task explicitly requires: "Your code should include checks that catch cases of non-log-concave densities during the sampling process" and "The 'ars' function must include checks for log-concavity during sampling."

Disabling check_log_concavity entirely violates this requirement. The false positives on normal distribution indicate the check implementation has numerical issues, but the check itself is a required feature, not a bug to eliminate.

Instead of disabling: consider alternative concavity testing methods (finite differences at multiple scales, checking second derivatives numerically with better precision, or testing only at newly added points rather than all comparisons). The check must detect and report actual non-log-concave inputs, even if the current tangent-line extrapolation approach is unreliable.
</context_for_action>
